If x - 1/x = 10, then find the value of frac{{{x⁴} + 1}}{{{x²}}}
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x - 1/x = 10

**Concept used:**

• (a - b)² = a² + b² - 2ab

• a² + b² = (a - b)² + 2ab

**Calculation:**

**frac{{{x⁴} + 1}}{{{x²}}}**

Dividing numerator and denominator by x², we get

⇒ frac{{{x⁴}/{x²} + 1/{x²}}}{{{x²}/{x²}}}

⇒ x² + 1/x² ---- (i)

According to the question,

x - 1/x = 10

Squaring both sides, we get

⇒ (x - 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² - 2

⇒ x² + 1/x² = (x - 1/x)² + 2 ---(ii)

Putting this value in eq (i) we get

x² + 1/x² = (10)² + 2 = 100 + 2 = 102

**∴ Value of the expression is 102**

⇒ x - 1/x = 10 then, x2 + 1/x² = 10² + 2 = 102

questions.question: If 35% of A is equal to 60% of B, then what is the ratio of A and B?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

35% of A is equal to 60% of B

**Calculation**:

According to the question

⇒ 35/100 × A = 60/100 × B

⇒ A/B = 60/35 = 12/7

**∴ the required ratio is 12 : 7**

questions.question: A bag contain equal number of 1 rupee, 50 paisa and 25 paisa coins. If the total amount is Rs. 105, then how many coins of each type are there?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A bag contain equal number of 1 rupee, 50 paisa and 25 paisa coins

**Calculation:**

Suppose one coin is x

According to the question

x + 0.5x + 0.25x = 105

⇒ 1.75x = 105

⇒ x = 105/1.75 = 60

**∴ Number of coins of each denomination is 60**

questions.question: The alcohol and water in a mixture are in the ratio of 7 : 8 respectively. If 11 litre water is added to it, then the ratio of alcohol and water in the new mixture becomes 3 : 5. What is the total quantity (in litres) of the alcohol in the new mixture?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The alcohol and water in a mixture are in the ratio of 7 : 8 respectively. If 11 litre water is added to it, then the ratio of alcohol and water in the new mixture becomes 3 : 5.

**Calculation:**

Suppose total mixture = 15x liters

Alcohol content = 7/15 × 15x = 7x liters

Water content = 15 - 7 = 8x liters

According to the question,

7x/(8x + 11) = 3/5

⇒ 35x = 24x + 33

⇒ 33 = 11x

⇒ x = 3

**∴ Alcohol content in final mixture 7 × 3 = 21 liters**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

The alcohol and water are in the ratio of 7 : 8

Now, 11 litre water is added and ratio becomes 3 : 5

So, we have to equal the unit of alcohol in both the ratio

So, water is added (35 - 24) = 11 unit → 11 litr

So, quantity of alcohol is 21 unit → 11/11 × 21 = 21 liters

questions.question: In a committee there are 15 members. If two members whose ages are 45 years and 55 years are replaced by two new members, then average age of 15 members is increased by 2 years. What is the average age (in years) of the new members?
questions.solution:
Calculation: 

Let the initial sum x of ages of 15 members = 15A

According to the question

15A - (45 + 55) + (2 new members) = 15(A + 2)

⇒ 15A - 100 + (2 new members) = 15A + 30

⇒ Sum of ages of 2 new members = 130

**∴ Average age of the 2 new members = 130/2 = 65 years**

questions.question: Simple interest on a sum of Rs. 1400 for 3 years and 4 months is Rs. 700. What is the rate (in percentage) of interest per annum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Simple interest on a sum of Rs. 1400 for 3 years and 4 months is Rs. 700

Concept used: 

S.I = (P × R × T)/100

Here, P = principal, R = rate, T = time, and S.I = simple interest

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

⇒ 700 = (1400 × R × 40)/(100 × 12)

**∴ R = 15%**

questions.question: The difference between cost price and selling price is Rs. 12.54. If loss percentage is 33%, then what is the cost price (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

C.P - S.P = 12.54, Loss percentage is 33%

**Concept used:**

Loss % = (C.P - S.P)/(C.P) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ 33 = (12.54)/(C.P) × 100

**∴ C.P = (12.54)/33 × 100 = Rs.38**

questions.question: Selling price of an article is Rs. 495 and discount of 5% is offered. What is the marked price (in Rs)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

S.P = Rs. 495, discount = 5%

**Calculation:**

Let the M.P be 100

S.P = 100x × 95/100

⇒ 495 = 100x × 95/100

⇒ x = 495/95

**∴ M.P = (495/95) × 100 = Rs. 521**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

We know 5% = 1/20

Here, 5% discount is offered, so, M.P = 20 and S.P = 19

According to the question, 19 unit → 495

Then, 20 unit → 495/19 × 20 = Rs.521

questions.question: X alone can do a piece of work in 12 days and Y alone can do the same work in 6 days. In how many days will both together complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

X alone can do a piece of work in 12 days and Y alone can do the same work in 6 days

**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Let the total work = 12 units

Efficiency of X = 12/12 = 1 unit/day

Efficiency of Y = 12/6 = 2 unit/day

Total efficiency of (X + Y) = 1 + 2 = 3 units/day

**∴ No. of days taken by them to finish the work = 12/3 = 4 days**

questions.question: A 800 metres long train is running at the speed of 90 km/hr. If it crosses a bridge in 50 seconds, then what is the length (in metres) of the bridge?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A 800 metres long train is running at the speed of 90 km/hr

**Concept used:**

• Speed = Distance/Time

• When a train crosses a bridge then it covers train + bridge's length

**Calculation:**

Let the length of the bridge is P

Speed in m/sec = 90 × 5/18 = 25 m/sec

According to the question

⇒ (800 + P)/25 = 50

⇒ P = 1250 - 800

**∴ P = 450 meters**

questions.question: If a regular polygon has 10 sides, then the measure of its interior angle is greater than the measure of its exterior angle by how many degrees?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

If the number of sides of a regular polygon be n, then

The interior angle =** ((n - 2) times 180^circ )/(n)**

**Calculation:**

Let the required difference be x.

No. of sides of a regular polygon = 10

According to the question

Rightarrow frac{{( {n - 2} ) times 180^circ }}{n} - frac{{360^circ }}{n} = x

Rightarrow frac{{( {10 - 2} ) times 180^circ }}{{10}} - frac{{360^circ }}{{10}} = x

Rightarrow frac{{8 times 180^circ }}{{10}} - 36^circ = x

⇒ 144 - 36° = x

**∴ x = 108°**

questions.question: In Quadrilateral ADEF measure of angle E is 90°. If tan D = 4/3, and DE = 6 cm, then what is the length (in cm) of side EF?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

tan D = 4/3, DE = 6 cm

**Concept used:**

Tan θ = perpendicular/base

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/721751888f78ba7f7cd99371faf5ead1006dd7518d348ab525511c10656d0c6e.png] 

Since tan D = 4/3

We know that Trigonometric identities are only applied to triangles.

So, we draw a triangle in the quadrilateral ADEF.

Thus, here two triangles are formed, you can apply 'tan D' in any of the triangles. Since the value of DE is given, so we will consider ΔFED

Now, in ΔFED,

tan D = p/b = EF / DE

⇒ 4/3 = EF/6

⇒ EF = 4/3 × 6 

⇒ EF = 8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cm**
